categories.name: Sculptural Mobiles
categories.description: Complex constructions that combine engineered geometry with responsive, suspended motion.

categories.name: Horizontal Mobiles
categories.description: Wide, layered works that carry movement across a room with long lines and shifting planes.

categories.name: Simple Mobiles
categories.description: Airy compositions built from a restrained vocabulary of balanced forms and color.

categories.description: Personalized works developed around a space, message, palette, or visual idea.

categories.description: Freestanding kinetic works scaled for shelves, tables, and intimate spaces.

categories.name: Wall-Mounted Mobiles
categories.description: Kinetic compositions designed to animate the plane of a wall.
